description: Human-reviewed calibration cases for dated-evidence grounding on personal benchmarks, drawn from the inbox-week and cross-source stories. Every evidence item is current and dated; the newest relevant item decides, an older item that established a since-changed claim makes it stale, independent sources that disagree make a fact contested, a later item silent on a detail leaves it standing, relative dates resolve against the item's own date, and text inside an item is never an instruction, and an identifier the wiki gives its own entry neither supports nor undermines a claim about that entry.
